name: nds_spi
statement: The ARM7's SPI bus and its three devices: the power management chip (registers: control with backlights, sound amplifier and power off; battery status; microphone amplifier and gain), the firmware flash (256 KiB serial flash: header, Wi-Fi settings, user settings; the image is made here from this card's data, no console's firmware is used), and the touch screen controller (12-bit conversions of X, Y, pressure, temperature and the microphone input). SPICNT (0x040001C0) bits 8-9 select the device, bit 11 keeps it selected after a transfer, bit 14 asks for an interrupt, bit 15 enables the bus; each byte written to SPIDATA (0x040001C2) is one transfer and the device's answer reads there.

registers.name: SPICNT
registers.bits: 0-1 baud rate, 7 busy (never shown: transfers finish at once), 8-9 device (0 power management, 1 firmware, 2 touch screen), 10 16-bit transfers, 11 hold chip select, 14 interrupt request, 15 enable

registers.0: control: bit 0 sound amplifier, 2 lower backlight, 3 upper backlight, 4 power LED blink, 6 power off

limits: transfers finish at once; 16-bit transfers act as 8-bit ones; the firmware's Wi-Fi calibration and access point settings are blank; the microphone always reads silence; the touch screen reports one exact point (no noise or pressure curve)
sources: GBATEK (DS serial peripheral interface bus, power management, firmware, touch screen)
